# Ladder (`equipment:ladder`)
**Categories:** [Adventuring Gear](../equipment-categories/adventuring-gear.md) | **Cost:** 1 sp | **Weight:** 25 lb.

A Ladder is 10 feet tall. You must climb to move up or down it. Lamp (5 SP)
